craft_claim: Irreverent voice treats the reader as a fellow insider who already shares the safe distance from the target, which is why breaking that shared stance — explaining the joke, moralizing mid-deflation — collapses the register.

supporting_evidence.note: Psychological distance from the violation is one of the three conditions that make it benign — the voice supplies that distance by narrating from alongside the reader rather than from above the target or below it.

supporting_evidence.location: Whole-book citation (Tier 4; bibliographic verification only this session)
supporting_evidence.note: Provine's book-length account treats laughter as fundamentally social and conversational — a coordination signal between co-present people, consistent with shared-stance reading of teasing.

supporting_evidence.location: Whole-work citation (SE vol. VIII; chapter locators unverified)
supporting_evidence.note: The joke's economy depends on the listener completing the forbidden step themselves — the pleasure is in the complicity, which direct explanation would forfeit.

counterevidence.note: Tier 4 trade book, cited at book level only; the social-laughter finding is well known but was not re-inspected in the text this session, so the claim leans mainly on the McGraw & Warren distance condition.

If the audience does not share the distance — reads the voice as an outsider mocking what they hold — the same lines land as contempt rather than conspiracy (failure mode governed by clm-tone-irreverent-licensed-frame).

scope: Narration and direct address where the reader is positioned as already-in on the deflation; chiefly comic narration, deadpan exposition, aside-to-the-reader passages.
exceptions: Where the reader's distance must be CREATED (unfamiliar sacred register), a beat of neutral setup before the deflation supplies it.
Moralizing explanation inside the deflation converts conspirator to prosecutor — the register fails (ties to clm-tone-irreverent-aggressive-style-drift).
